results.title: New taxi fares introduced in Portugal
results.description: From 23 October, Portugal's taxi fare system will follow new rules on how journeys are priced.

results.title: 2027 utility rates in Jamestown recommended for approval
results.description: JAMESTOWN — The Jamestown Finance and Legal Committee recommended approval on a 3-2 vote of the 2027 utility rates beginning Jan. 1.

results.title: Samrat to launch Gaya manufacturing city today
results.description: CM Samrat Choudhary launches 1,670-acre Bihar Integrated Manufacturing City in Gaya as state cites Rs 1 lakh crore proposals, new industrial land and parks.

results.title: Silverstein Estate Hit With $4M Penalty Over Lead Paint in 1,000-Unit Portfolio
results.description: U.S. Attorney's Office says the estate of landlord Harry D. Silverstein will pay $4 million to settle lead-paint safety violations across 1,000-plus units.
